mapper.sql: general_ledgers.id AS id, general_ledgers.date AS date, (SELECT branch_id FROM general_ledger_details WHERE general_ledger_id = general_ledgers.id LIMIT 1) AS branchId, (SELECT name FROM branches WHERE id = (SELECT branch_id FROM general_ledger_details WHERE general_ledger_id = general_ledgers.id LIMIT 1)) AS branchName, general_ledgers.reference AS reference, general_ledgers.is_adj AS adj, general_ledgers.deposit_type AS `type`, IFNULL(general_ledgers.is_approve, 0) AS status, IFNULL(general_ledgers.recurrence, 0) AS isRecurrence, COALESCE(general_ledgers.note, '') AS note, DATE_FORMAT(general_ledgers.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(general_ledgers.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM general_ledgers LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = general_ledgers.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = general_ledgers.modified_by

general_ledger_details.id AS id, general_ledger_details.general_ledger_id AS journalEntryId, general_ledger_details.chart_account_id AS `chartAccountId`, CONCAT(chart_accounts.account_codes, ' - ', chart_accounts.account_description) AS chartAccountName, general_ledger_details.memo AS description, general_ledger_details.class_id AS `classId`, classes.name AS `className`, general_ledger_details.type AS `type`, general_ledger_details.debit AS `debit`, general_ledger_details.credit AS `credit`, general_ledger_details.customer_id AS customerId, customers.name AS customerName, general_ledger_details.vendor_id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, general_ledger_details.employee_id AS employeeId, employees.name AS employeeName, general_ledger_details.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName

FROM general_ledger_details LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = general_ledger_details.chart_account_id LEFT JOIN classes ON classes.id = general_ledger_details.class_id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = general_ledger_details.customer_id LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = general_ledger_details.vendor_id LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.id = general_ledger_details.employee_id LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = general_ledger_details.company_id
mapper.select: SELECT file_name AS name, file_url AS url FROM general_ledger_files WHERE is_active = 1 AND general_ledger_id = #{journalId}
SELECT reference FROM general_ledgers WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(NOW()) AND `reference` LIKE '%OR%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT reference FROM pay_bills WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(NOW()) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT account_description AS name, account_codes AS code FROM chart_accounts WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT exchange_rate AS exchangeRate, cheque_number AS chequeNumber FROM receive_payments WHERE gl_id = #{id}
SELECT exchange_rate AS exchangeRate, cheque_number AS chequeNumber FROM pay_bills WHERE gl_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO general_ledgers( sys_code, `date`, reference, note, is_sys, is_adj, is_approve, is_depreciated, is_retained_earnings, recurrence, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( UUID(), #{journalEntry.date}, #{journalEntry.reference}, #{journalEntry.note}, 0, #{journalEntry.adj}, #{journalEntry.isApprove}, 0, 0, #{journalEntry.isRecurrence}, NOW(), #{journalEntry.createdBy}, #{journalEntry.isActive} );

INSERT INTO general_ledger_details( general_ledger_id, chart_account_id, company_id, branch_id, location_group_id, location_id, type, debit, credit, memo, customer_id, vendor_id, employee_id, class_id, is_reconcile, modified ) VALUES ( #{journalEntryDetail.generalLedgerId}, #{journalEntryDetail.chartAccountId}, #{journalEntryDetail.companyId}, #{journalEntryDetail.branchId}, null, null, #{journalEntryDetail.type}, #{journalEntryDetail.debit}, #{journalEntryDetail.credit}, #{journalEntryDetail.memo}, #{journalEntryDetail.customerId}, #{journalEntryDetail.vendorId}, #{journalEntryDetail.employeeId}, #{journalEntryDetail.classId}, 0, NOW() );

INSERT INTO receive_payments( sys_code, `date`, company_id, branch_id, customer_id, gl_id, type_id, total_amount, deposit_to, account_codes, account_description, reference, note, exchange_rate, cheque_number, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( UUID(), #{journalEntryDetail.date}, #{journalEntryDetail.companyId}, #{journalEntryDetail.branchId}, #{journalEntryDetail.customerId}, #{journalEntryDetail.generalLedgerId}, 1, #{journalEntryDetail.totalDebit}, #{journalEntryDetail.chartAccountId}, #{journalEntryDetail.chartAccountCode}, #{journalEntryDetail.chartAccountName}, #{journalEntryDetail.reference}, #{journalEntryDetail.memo}, #{journalEntryDetail.exchangeRate}, #{journalEntryDetail.cheque}, NOW(), #{journalEntryDetail.createdBy}, 1 );

INSERT INTO pay_bills( `date`, type_id, company_id, branch_id, vendor_id, gl_id, exchange_rate, deposit_to, account_codes, account_description, cheque_number, reference, note, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{journalEntryDetail.date}, 1, #{journalEntryDetail.companyId}, #{journalEntryDetail.branchId}, #{journalEntryDetail.vendorId}, #{journalEntryDetail.generalLedgerId}, #{journalEntryDetail.exchangeRate}, #{journalEntryDetail.chartAccountId}, #{journalEntryDetail.chartAccountCode}, #{journalEntryDetail.chartAccountName}, #{journalEntryDetail.cheque}, #{journalEntryDetail.reference}, #{journalEntryDetail.memo}, NOW(), #{journalEntryDetail.createdBy}, 1 );

INSERT INTO general_ledger_files( general_ledger_id, `file_name`, file_url, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{journalId}, #{journalEntryFileRequest.name}, #{journalEntryFileRequest.url}, NOW(), 1, 1 );
mapper.update: UPDATE general_ledgers SET `date` = #{journalEntry.date}, `reference` = #{journalEntry.reference}, `note` = #{journalEntry.note}, `is_adj` = #{journalEntry.adj}, `recurrence` = #{journalEntry.isRecurrence}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{journalEntry.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{journalEntry.id}
